title: 大阪杯の後に・遠くなった背中

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket commits the entirety of her abilities, but ends up losing against the more vigorous Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling pressured by Taishin's display, Ticket tells herself that she needs to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, she sets her sights on the Takarazuka Kinen, the race to conclude the first half of the Twinkle Series.
